title: 'We have great leverage here': DNC chair Ken Martin on Democrats' midterms sweep
summary: Democrats flipped Senate seats in Republican strongholds and won control of Congress. DNC chair Ken Martin explains why he believes voters gave his party a mandate and what comes next.
contentText:
Morning Edition on Wednesday about Democrats' midterm election victories.'/> Democrats flipped Senate seats in Republican strongholds and won control of Congress. DNC chair Ken Martin explains why he believes voters gave his party a mandate and what comes next.
